verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes are explicitly designed as isolated VM/container environments for running untrusted code, separate from production infra, with sessions, snapshots, and opt-in bindings to access KV/R2/Durable Objects only when explicitly wired in — matching the AI-native 'test without touching production' need well (docs-34, docs-38, docs-50, docs-20, docs-24). Community feedback doesn't contradict the isolation guarantee itself, though it flags coarse outbound network controls and unclear persistence semantics as caveats (cloudflare-sandbox-comm-2, cloudflare-sandbox-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that no production data leakage occurs in practice, and finer-grained egress/network isolation controls.
